services_shape: visits of a set length, booked with a urologist or a nurse practitioner by name; a new patient's consult is longer and the owner OKs it; follow-ups and same-day visits are for current patients; an office test or procedure is booked by the office after a consult, or added at a visit only with the patient's yes; a home catheter check has a 2-hour arrival window; adults only
questions_before_times: a new or a current patient
which visit: the practice's own visit types only, never a symptom or a reason typed into the AI
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video follow-up: which state the patient will be in
who the visit is for: the person booking, or another adult
safety_stop: no urine at all with a swollen, hard belly, blood in the urine with clots and a fever, sudden severe pain in the groin or testicle, or a fever with back or side pain
chest pain, signs of a stroke (a drooping face, a weak arm, slurred speech, a sudden severe headache), or fainting
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
first_steps: Health history, medicines, the consent and the privacy notice
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
Records and past test results from the last doctor
A referral, where the plan asks for one
Sam's OK for a new patient
license: optional: the business may add any license or registration it holds (a clinician's, a practice's); Rosie never requires one and never looks one up
staff_skills: the urologist (Ines): new patient consults, follow-ups, same-day visits, office tests, office procedures and video follow-ups; the nurse practitioners (Pete at the office, Ray at home): follow-ups, catheter checks and home visits; only people the owner clears for home visits go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, the body part, symptoms, medicines, results or the clinician's name (at a home visit the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
